entities.name: Francisca Ramírez Torres
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisca Ramírez Tórrez is a Nicaraguan farmer and peasants (campesinos) rights activist. She has been a leader of protests that began in 2014 against the proposed development of an inter-oceanic canal through Nicaragua and for the repeal of the 2013 legislation granting Chinese company HKND the concession for the canal and other infrastructure projects.
